attributes.title: TPA Winter Meeting 2027
attributes.summary:
The Tennessee Pharmacists Association holds its 2027 Winter Meeting January 29 to 31, 2027, at the Sonesta Nashville Airport. TPA calls it the association's most prominent yearly networking and education conference, and it is open to pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, student pharmacists, exhibitors and friends of pharmacy.

The meeting combines educational sessions and workshops that carry continuing education credit with regulatory updates and an exhibit hall. The number of CE hours, the program and fees are not published yet; TPA says registration usually opens in late fall or early winter.

Companies interested in exhibiting or sponsoring can contact TPA directly; a call for CE presenters is also open.
